input_fields.name: object_collection
input_fields.description: One already resolved collection and its declared scope/type.

input_fields.name: expected_count
input_fields.description: Expected nonnegative integer count for this collection.

result_fields.name: count_result
result_fields.description: Actual integer count, expected count, scope, and comparison evidence.

procedure: Validate collection scope and count semantics before counting.
Count exactly the supplied collection once and compare it with expected_count.
Return count_result and comparison_status with the collection identity.
Do not expand the scope to similar objects or infer a body/face count from another collection.
rejection_rules: Reject a non-integer/negative expected_count or an unbounded collection.
Reject mixed object types or a scope inferred from visual pixels.
Do not treat equal counts as member identity or geometry agreement.
